chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 488: Ji Ning Discovers the Tragic Fate of His Parents' Rebirth
chapter_meta_description: Lord Yan reveals the reincarnation records of Ji Yichuan and Yuchi Snow. A beautiful second chance turns to tragedy, shattering Ji Ning's Dao-heart and driving him to seek the truth from time itself.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 488: The Verdict of Time
og_description: Ji Ning finally learns the fate of his parents' second life, but the truth is a bitter blow that forces him to question the very judgment of the heavens.
twitter_description: Ji Ning's search for his parents ends in tragedy. Now, he will defy the laws of the Netherworld to see the truth with his own eyes.

lore_anchors.definition: A localized recreation of the original Six Paths of Reincarnation, established by Daofather Crimsonbright after the ancient war shattered the original system. It manages the souls of dozens of major worlds under his dominion.
The supreme ruler of a division within the Netherworld's bureaucracy, overseeing the judgment and reincarnation of souls. Lord Yan serves as a King of Hell in the Small Cycle of Reincarnation.
An Immortal-level spell that projects a visual recreation of past events in a specific location, allowing a cultivator to witness history without interacting with it.
The standard enforcer ghost-soldiers of the Netherworld, known for their fearsome animal heads and their duty to escort and supervise souls.
A major world under the jurisdiction of the Small Cycle of Reincarnation, located far from the Grand Xia World, where Ji Ning’s parents were reborn.
A concept in Xianxia where the fates of two souls are intertwined across multiple reincarnations, often dictating that they will find each other in each new life.
